text:
5 former Fenwick High School athletes on college rosters for week ending Sept. 6
Five former Fenwick High School athletes are listed on college rosters for the week ending Sept. 6. Senior Shannon O'Laughlin is on Elon women's volleyball. Elon is scheduled to visit UNC Asheville on Sept. 1.
The listed athletes represent men's soccer, men's water polo, women's volleyball and women's soccer. Elon, George Washington, Grinnell, Minnesota, and Tufts are represented. The teams have 16 scheduled events during the week ending Sept. 6.
College teams and scheduled events for each athlete are listed below.
Former Fenwick High School Athletes Scheduled for College Action — Week Ending September 6
Alec Posluszny
George Washington men's water polo — A-10
Schedule: Hosts Princeton on September 4 in Annapolis, MD; Hosts Iona on September 5 in Annapolis, MD; Hosts LIU on September 5 in Annapolis, MD; Hosts Air Force on September 6 in Annapolis, MD; Hosts Chapman on September 6 in Annapolis, MD
Shannon O'Laughlin
Elon women's volleyball — CAA
Schedule: Visits UNC Asheville on September 1 in Asheville, NC; Visits Duquesne on September 4 in Pittsburgh, PA; Visits Robert Morris University on September 4 in Moon Township, PA; Hosts Eastern Michigan on September 5 in Pittsburgh, PA
Lola Tortorello
Tufts women's volleyball — NESCAC
Schedule: Hosts Berry College (Ga.) on September 5 in Scranton, PA; Visits University of Scranton on September 5 in Scranton, PA; Hosts Ithaca College on September 6 in Scranton, PA
Jacqueline Gabbert
Minnesota women's soccer — Big Ten
Schedule: Hosts Colorado College on September 6 in Elizabeth Lyle Robbie Stadium
Jake Brecknock
Grinnell men's soccer — Midwest
Schedule: Visits Coe College on September 1 in Cedar Rapids, IA; Hosts Hamline University on September 5 in Grinnell, IA; Hosts Alumni Game on September 6 in Grinnell, IA
